units: Targ. Ps. XXXIV, 6 (v. חֲסַד II).—Part. pass. עָצֵב, עָצִיב; f. עֲצִיבָא; pl. עֲצִיבֵי grieved, sad.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Esther 4:1">Targ. Esth. IV, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 12:31">Targ. Y. Ex. XII, 31</cite> <he>קל ע׳</he> the voice of a mourner.—
<cite ref="Beitzah 16b:7">Bets. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>חזייה דהוה ע׳</he> he saw that he looked down-hearted; <he>אמאי עֲצִיבַת</he> why art thou grieved? <cite ref="Taanit 25a">Taan. 25ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Taanit 22a:7">Ib. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>מבדחינן ע׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B00117"><he>בָּדוֹחָא</he></cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Berakhot 31a:1">Ber. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>ואִעֲצִיבוּ</he> and they grew sad; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 881:1">Yalk. Ps. 881</cite> <he>ואִיעֲ׳</he>.
